'''2001 Denver DPC warm-up tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Denver, Colorado on 31 August 2001. [[Brian Hunter]] won it. It is known from Mark Ponting's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2929">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-04-denver-dpc-10-01-2001d2929/ denver-dpc-10-01-2001], DeckTech (Mark "The Maker" Ponting, 4 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-04-denver-dpc-10-01-2001d2929/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2001 Denver DPC]].

* '''Date:''' 31 August 2001
* '''Site:''' Denver, Colorado
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Players:''' 11
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Hunter]]
